capabilities: Capture short memos into a configured daily note heading or file end
Parse timestamped list entries like '- 12:00 abcd' from diary files
Browse captured memos in a sidebar with a heatmap and multiple layouts (Pro)
Read memos from multiple sources beyond daily notes (Pro)
Sync memos across devices via paid Thino Sync (not yet available)
extras: Closed source since version 2.0.0 (v1 remains MIT-licensed); freemium with Pro features behind a paid license; the Pro sync service is listed as not yet available; the plugin was renamed from obsidian-memos to thino; most feature details are deferred to an external documentation site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in fast way to jot short thoughts into daily notes and browse them later as a timeline.

relations.evidence: You need to activate the Daily Notes core plugin at a minimum

summary: Quick capture tool that stores timestamped memos inside daily notes and lists them in a sidebar with a heatmap.
